user.title: Set up Zeitarchiv
user.description: Connection to a Zeitarchiv add-on. Multiple named destinations can run in parallel, for example production and test. Find the API token in the add-on's settings.

reconfigure.title: Zeitarchiv – Update connection
reconfigure.description: Update host/port/token — e.g. if the token was regenerated or cleared in the add-on's settings ("Connection" section).

reauth_confirm.title: Zeitarchiv – Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on rejected the stored API token — it was probably regenerated or cleared in the add-on's settings ("Connection" section). Enter the new token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the add-on. Is it running and is the port reachable?
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the API token.

init.title: Zeitarchiv – Settings
init.description: Use labels to choose what Zeitarchiv captures, or safely transfer filters between Home Assistant systems.

menu_option_descriptions.filters: Prefer labels; additional selection methods and exclusions are optional.
menu_option_descriptions.overview: Review included, stateless, and excluded entities.
menu_option_descriptions.export: Copy the current filters without host or API token.
menu_option_descriptions.import: Read a Zeitarchiv export and replace the current filters.

filters.title: Zeitarchiv – Archive filters
filters.description: Labels are the recommended selection method. Directly labelled entities and entities belonging to labelled devices or areas are included. Multiple labels use OR logic; later label changes apply to subsequent state changes without saving the options again. Configure resolution and retention in Zeitarchiv itself (Settings → Archiving).

data_description.labels: A label may be assigned directly to an entity, a device, or an area. Exclusions always take precedence.

additional_selection.name: Additional selection methods
additional_selection.description: Optionally include individual entities, areas, devices, or patterns.

data_description.entity_patterns: One pattern per line. Patterns without a dot match the object ID (`*_power`); patterns with a dot match the full entity ID (`sensor.weather_*`). `*` and `?` are supported.

exclusions.name: Exclusions
exclusions.description: Exceptions apply regardless of how an entity was selected.

data_description.exclude_entity_patterns: One pattern per line. Exclusions always take precedence, for example `*_id` or `sensor.*_raw`.

value_processing.name: Value processing
value_processing.description: Controls how numeric measurements are prepared before transmission.

data_description.decimal_places: Numeric measurements are rounded before transmission; you can select between 0 and 3 decimal places. Recommended: 3 (default). Fewer places may save storage but can reduce the accuracy of fine-grained readings. Switch states are stored as 1/0 regardless of this setting.

filter_preview.title: Zeitarchiv – Filter preview

overview.title: Zeitarchiv – Currently included entities

export.title: Zeitarchiv – Export filters
export.description: Copy the YAML content and save it as a file, or paste it into “Import filters from YAML” on another system. Host and API token are not included. Note that labels, areas, and devices use internal IDs. Select “Submit” to return to the menu.

import.title: Zeitarchiv – Import filters
import.description: Paste a previously exported Zeitarchiv YAML document. Importing replaces all current filters. Labels, areas, and devices only work if their internal IDs match on this system. Domains in older exports are converted once into the currently known concrete entities.

error.invalid_structure: The content is not a valid Zeitarchiv filter export.
error.unsupported_format: This export format or version is not supported.
error.invalid_domain: The export contains an unsupported domain.
error.invalid_entity: The export contains an invalid entity ID.
error.invalid_pattern: The pattern is invalid. Entity ID characters plus * and ? are allowed.
error.too_many_patterns: Each pattern field supports at most 100 entries.
